chapters.note: Opens with Gone Fishing. Do the Chapter 1 meditation at Jason's house before the chapter ends.
Coffee Break unlocks switching between Jason and Lucia and playing together — most partner trophies open up here.
Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs unlocks the Snap Gun and jewelry robberies; the Key Cloner arrives with Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS.
That's Where The Money Is… unlocks bank vault robberies and the armored-truck trophy.
Operation Savage Glory. After the credits, free-roam opens with the 100% checklist.

steps.name: Finish the story, and do the one missable thing
steps.text: Play the story through its 5 chapters and enjoy it — there are no mission gold medals to chase, and progress toward the 100% checklist already counts while you play. Do the side content you find as you go, or leave it all for after the story; everything needed for trophies is still available in free-roam. Two habits pay off: scan every new vehicle with the WAiNK app (hold Up, then R1) and study every new animal with the binoculars (hold L1 for the weapon wheel, zoom with Up, hold R1 to study), because the checklist needs 200 of 277 vehicles and 100 of 255 animals. And keep manual saves at the start and end of each chapter, since there is no mission replay.
steps.watch: The only potentially missable trophy is Positive Mental Attitude: the first meditation, at Jason's house in Chapter 1, is gone after Chapter 1. After the mission “Down to Earth”, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning, follow her to the balcony and choose “Accept”.

steps.name: The 100% completion checklist and 70 of 80 challenges
steps.text: After the story, the 100% checklist unlocks under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion. Its requirements are lenient — closer to 60% true completion. Most side quests are not required, and collectibles are only partly required. The lines that need everything are robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's quests. You need any 100 optional missions (there are far more than 100), 70 of 80 challenges, 300 of 397 stunts, 200 of 277 vehicles scanned, 100 of 255 animals studied, 15 of 18 meditations, all 8 bank vaults, all 39 gang operations and all 15 target decks. Work through the checklist and the long-grind trophies — Cunning Stunts, The Shootist, Top Fun, One Last Thing and A Long Road itself — will pop along the way.
steps.watch: Do optional missions as they appear: they introduce new features, and each vehicle delivery for Moses and Randy counts. Each meditation done with both Jason and Lucia counts +2.

steps.name: Strangers & Freaks and miscellaneous cleanup
steps.text: Strangers & Freaks are not needed for 100%, so they are the last big block: 8 qualifying mission strands (Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete are confirmed counters). Then sweep up whatever is left — the partner robberies (Hot Together, Retail Therapy), the vehicle and money trophies (Little Boxes, On the Spot, Treat Yo Self), the odd one-offs (Catch Me If You Can, Challenging Tank, The Goodtime State) and the five trophies whose methods are still unknown (In The Beginning…, Capital Offense, Bad Luck, I Guess, The Truth Is Out There, Ten Pin) — check their guides for the latest word. The platinum pops when the last of the 54 is earned.
steps.watch: Cheats disable trophies and saving, and cheats only unlock after the story — keep them off for the whole run.

summary: One playthrough, about 200 hours, no online trophies. The story takes 60–80 hours; the 100% completion checklist takes about 100 more; Strangers & Freaks and miscellaneous cleanup take the last 10. There is free-roam after the story but no mission replay, so keep a manual save at the start and end of each chapter (the game has 15 manual save slots and 1 autosave slot).
title: Road to the Platinum
